## lineagefreq

**Lineage Frequency Dynamics from Genomic Surveillance Counts**

Version: 0.2.0 (CRAN) / 0.6.0 (dev)

[![CRAN status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/lineagefreq)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=lineagefreq)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/CuiweiG/lineagefreq/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/CuiweiG/lineagefreq/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

Multinomial logistic regression for pathogen variant frequency dynamics,
growth advantage estimation, and short-term forecasting with rolling-origin
backtesting. Five engines (frequentist and Bayesian) behind a unified
interface; ships with real CDC SARS-CoV-2 data.

**Links:**
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=lineagefreq) |
[GitHub](https://github.com/CuiweiG/lineagefreq) |
[Documentation](https://cuiweig.github.io/lineagefreq)

**Install:**

```r
install.packages("lineagefreq")
```

**Core functions:**

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `fit_model()` | Fit a lineage frequency model using any of five engines |
| `growth_advantage()` | Estimate relative growth advantages from a fitted model |
| `forecast()` | Generate short-term frequency forecasts |
| `backtest()` | Rolling-origin cross-validation for forecast evaluation |
| `score_forecasts()` | Score forecast accuracy with proper scoring rules |

## survinger

**Design-Adjusted Inference for Pathogen Lineage Surveillance**

Version: 0.1.1

[![CRAN status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/survinger)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=survinger)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/CuiweiG/survinger/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/CuiweiG/survinger/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

Design-adjusted prevalence estimation for genomic surveillance under
unequal sequencing rates, using Horvitz–Thompson and Hajek estimators
with right-truncation delay correction and Neyman-optimal resource
allocation.

**Links:**
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=survinger) |
[GitHub](https://github.com/CuiweiG/survinger) |
[Documentation](https://cuiweig.github.io/survinger)

**Install:**

```r
install.packages("survinger")
```

**Core functions:**

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `surv_design()` | Define a surveillance sampling design |
| `surv_lineage_prevalence()` | Estimate lineage prevalence with design adjustment |
| `surv_optimize_allocation()` | Neyman-optimal allocation of sequencing resources |
| `surv_adjusted_prevalence()` | Adjusted prevalence with right-truncation correction |

## clinicalfair

**Algorithmic Fairness Assessment for Clinical Prediction Models**

Version: 0.1.1

[![CRAN status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/clinicalfair)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=clinicalfair)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/CuiweiG/clinicalfair/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/CuiweiG/clinicalfair/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

Model-agnostic fairness auditing for clinical prediction models. Computes
group-stratified metrics with bootstrap CIs, flags four-fifths rule
violations, and performs intersectional analysis and threshold-based
mitigation.

**Links:**
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=clinicalfair) |
[GitHub](https://github.com/CuiweiG/clinicalfair) |
[Documentation](https://cuiweig.github.io/clinicalfair)

**Install:**

```r
install.packages("clinicalfair")
```

**Core functions:**

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `fairness_data()` | Prepare data for fairness analysis |
| `fairness_metrics()` | Compute group-stratified performance metrics |
| `fairness_report()` | Generate a four-fifths rule compliance report |
| `threshold_optimize()` | Find group-specific thresholds to equalize metrics |
| `intersectional_fairness()` | Intersectional subgroup fairness analysis |

## syntheticdata

**Synthetic Clinical Data Generation and Privacy-Preserving Validation**

Version: 0.1.1

[![CRAN status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/syntheticdata)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=syntheticdata)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/CuiweiG/syntheticdata/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/CuiweiG/syntheticdata/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

Synthetic clinical data generation via Gaussian copula, bootstrap, and
Laplace noise, with integrated distributional validation, privacy risk
assessment, and downstream model fidelity testing.

**Links:**
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=syntheticdata) |
[GitHub](https://github.com/CuiweiG/syntheticdata) |
[Documentation](https://cuiweig.github.io/syntheticdata)

**Install:**

```r
install.packages("syntheticdata")
```

**Core functions:**

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `synthesize()` | Generate synthetic data using copula, bootstrap, or noise methods |
| `validate_synthetic()` | Distributional validation of synthetic vs. original data |
| `privacy_risk()` | Membership inference and attribute disclosure risk assessment |
| `model_fidelity()` | Compare downstream model performance on real vs. synthetic data |
| `compare_methods()` | Benchmark multiple synthesis methods side by side |
